verdict.rationale: Exa's own docs cover every step of the story in one API. Search returns clean page content and query-relevant highlights in the same request (exa-docs-22, exa-docs-36, exa-docs-35). Deep Search provides "multi-step research with structured outputs and citations" via "iterative search, reasoning, and grounded synthesis" (exa-docs-45, exa-docs-25). The Exa Agent API runs async deep research and returns grounded answers or schema-validated JSON (exa-docs-66, exa-docs-47), and agents can trigger it through the MCP `agent_run` tool (exa-docs-50, exa-docs-40). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end search→extract→synthesize research flow; community reports cover search-API use and Websets, not Deep Search or Agent runs.
